title: Fix Core state transition precedence for low-scoring Core records
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that MemoryStateMachine.Evaluate first assigns Core -> Deprecated below DeprecationThreshold, then overwrites it with Core -> Working in a later independent branch. This makes very-low-scoring Core records impossible to deprecate through the state machine. Evidence: MemorySmith.Core/StateMachine/MemoryStateMachine.cs lines 17-45. Make transition precedence mutually exclusive and add boundary tests for Core scores below both thresholds.
